description: This file contains a modular script for object detection, classification, and pose estimation on videos using ultralytics YOLO models. It loads a video file, processes each frame to detect animals ('bear', 'dog', 'giraffe'), crops detections, classifies and estimates pose on each crop, and prints per-frame summaries.

methods.description: Find the first .mp4 file in the specified directory.

methods.description: Create a cv2.VideoCapture object for the given file path.

methods.description: Extracts the first frame from a given video file.

methods.description: Load detection, classification, and pose models using ultralytics YOLO.

methods.name: Any run_detection(detector: Any, frame_bgr: np.ndarray)
methods.description: Run object detection on a frame.

methods.description: Filter detection results to include only target labels.

methods.name: List[Tuple[Dict[str,Any],np.ndarray]] crop_detections(frame_bgr: np.ndarray, detections: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Crop detected regions from the original frame.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] classify_crops(classifier: Any, crops: List[Tuple[Dict[str, Any], np.ndarray]])
methods.description: Classify cropped images to identify specific animals.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] pose_on_crops(pose_model: Any, crops: List[Tuple[Dict[str, Any], np.ndarray]])
methods.description: Estimate human keypoints (pose) on each cropped image.

methods.description: Print a summary of detections, classifications, and pose results for a frame.

methods.description: Generator that yields frames from the video.

methods.description: Run detection, classification, pose estimation, and print results for a single frame.

methods.description: Main function to run the entire pipeline on a specified or auto-detected MP4 file, processing all frames.
